title: Integral internal Hom and reduction
statement:
Fix the integral coefficient datum of [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]: a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $t=\varpi_E$, and a scheme $X$. On the small pro-etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $B=R_X=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(R/t^n)_X$, $A_n=R/t^n$, and $B_n=(A_n)_X$. Write $D(B)$ and $D(B_n)$ for the unbounded derived categories of module sheaves. Let $F_n=-\otimes_B^L B_n:D(B)\to D(B_n)$ be derived reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] and let $U_n=\operatorname{Res}_n:D(B_n)\to D(B)$ be derived restriction of scalars [def-weil-integral-derived-restriction-of-scalars]. Internal Hom is the ambient ringed-site derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], denoted $H_B$ and $H_{B_n}$.

For arbitrary $K,L\in D(B)$ and every integer $n\geq1$, set $K_n=F_nK$ and $L_n=F_nL$. The canonical map
$$
 c_{n,K,L}:F_nH_B(K,L)\longrightarrow H_{B_n}(K_n,L_n)
$$
is an isomorphism in $D(B_n)$. Here $c_{n,K,L}$ is the transpose of the pairing
$$
 F_nK\otimes_{B_n}^LF_nH_B(K,L)
 \xrightarrow{\sim}F_n(K\otimes_B^LH_B(K,L))
 \xrightarrow{F_n(\operatorname{ev}_{K,L})}F_nL.
$$
Thus the comparison preserves evaluation and its transposes under tensor-Hom adjunction. If $L$ is derived complete in the sense of [def-weil-derived-complete], then $H_B(K,L)$ is derived complete. No boundedness, constructibility or site-perfectness assumption on $K$ or $L$ is imposed in the comparison, and completeness of $K$ is not required.

proof.text: Obtain normalized source and finite reduction presentations from models_exist.
Apply Roos transport to derived completeness in the second variable.
Apply comparison_isIso at each finite level.
Use adjunction counit and naturality for the displayed equations.

split_report.summary: Made the previously unbound coefficient notation and categories explicit, preserving all clauses. Expanded the finite-free coefficient argument to a signed chain isomorphism, constructed the internal coefficient-adjunction comparison via Hom bijections, identified the evaluation-defined map, and proved completeness by applying the actual right adjoint to the Roos triangle. Reused existing nodes; no new nodes. The small-etale Lean declarations do not attach the full pro-etale statement, and the full comparison there still has sorry. Rebased against live DAG tip a80ba567c0686df5898bb0fe646344706177b1af and tightened the right-adjoint limit step after re-reading changed dependency statements. Second reader corrected Step 2 to use global hypercohomology, distinguished the two evaluation orders, and replaced the Step 8 tower/product claim by projection equations for 1-s; the original blueprint and Stacks sources were recovered and read in the launcher literature copy. Cited the existing DVR theorem explicitly to verify the completion lemma’s Noetherian hypothesis; the final proof uses twenty-one existing dependencies.

lean.statement: theorem integralHomReduction : ∃ a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl), (∀ K L : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E Y D hl, IsDerivedComplete l E Y D hl L → IsDerivedComplete l E Y D hl ((IntegralHom.hom.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl)).obj (op K, L))) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : IntegralHom.ReductionPresentation l E Y D hl a n, ∀ K L : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E Y D hl, IsIso (IntegralHom.comparison l E Y D hl m K L) ∧ (m.target.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl n).obj K)) (IntegralHom.comparison l E Y D hl m K L)) ≫ (m.target.adjunction ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl n).obj K)).counit.app ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl n).obj L) = m.mu.inv.app (K, (IntegralHom.hom.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl)).obj (op K, L)) ≫ (integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl n).map ((a.adjunction K).counit.app L)) ∧ ∀ (T : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E Y D hl) (f : T ⟶ (IntegralHom.hom.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl)).obj (op K, L)), (m.target.adjunction ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl n).obj K)).homEquiv ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl n).obj T) ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl n).obj L) (m.mu.inv.app (K, T) ≫ (integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl n).map (((a.adjunction K).homEquiv T L).symm f)) = (integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl n).map f ≫ IntegralHom.comparison l E Y D hl m K L
lean.note: Canonical uncompleted tensor and evaluation are specified by their K-flat/K-injective representatives at independent site and coefficient universes. The theorem supplies those normalized presentations; comparison is the actual adjoint transpose of reduced evaluation, with invertibility, evaluation and arbitrary-transpose compatibilities, and completeness in the second variable. The 25 unchanged interface definitions are publicly re-exported from Sheaf.Paper.IntegralHomReductionModels; their attachment is def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models.
